name: Black chicken hotpot
summary: A Đồng Văn hotpot of black chicken, white radish, mushroom, and fresh greens including cải mèo, peas, and forest vegetables. Dân Việt says the chicken is a rare free-range bird.
origin: Đồng Văn, and on the highland trip, on Dân Việt.
taste: Dân Việt says the chicken is firm, fragrant, and naturally sweet.
howToEat: Eat it as a hotpot. No clock is given.
where: Đồng Văn, or on the highland trip.
seoTitle: Black chicken hotpot in Dong Van — lau ga den
seoDescription: Lẩu gà đen is black chicken with white radish, mushroom, cải mèo, peas, and forest vegetables. Dân Việt calls the bird firm, fragrant, and naturally sweet.
